global.summaryZh: 丹麦外交大臣宣布将驱逐俄罗斯驻哥本哈根的国防武官，原因是俄罗斯涉嫌参与针对一名乌克兰说唱歌手的暗杀企图。丹麦政府同时考虑暂停对俄发放申根签证。

items.titleZh: 瑞士外交官称瑞士对华免税出口协议将惠及香港
items.summaryZh: 随着中瑞升级自由贸易协定，瑞士对华出口关税的取消将为香港的金融、物流和法律行业带来机遇。瑞士正寻求在香港北部都会区开展更多研发合作。
items.whyImportant: 该协议的实施有望加强中瑞经贸联系，并为香港作为国际贸易枢纽提供新的增长动力。

items.title: Japan wants an Asian energy agency. Will the region buy in?
items.summary: Asia already has oil-sharing pacts it has never used. Now, Japan wants to add another that critics warn will do little to solve the region’s dependence on energy imports and may simply add another level of bureaucracy. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi announced the plan on Tuesday at an Asia Zero-Emission Community leaders’ meeting in Manila, on the sidelines of this year’s Asean summit. “We would like to position this as an Asian version of the IEA,” Takaichi said, referring to the...
items.titleZh: 日本提议建立亚洲能源机构，该地区会买账吗？
items.summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗提议建立一个类似于国际能源署（IEA）的亚洲能源机构，旨在应对能源进口依赖问题。然而，批评人士认为该计划可能只会增加官僚机构，且难以解决该地区的能源安全挑战。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了日本试图在亚洲能源政策中发挥领导作用，但其有效性仍面临地区合作意愿和实际执行力的质疑。

items.title: Trump turns White House press conference into a 2028 succession audition
items.summary: The president appeared to put Vance and Rubio through their paces as potential successors, though Stephen Miller unexpectedly stole the spotlight “Which of you shall we say doth love us most?” The ageing King Lear’s question to his daughters, expecting them to compete for his favour and carve up his kingdom, hovered in the White House press briefing room on Friday. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 特朗普将白宫新闻发布会变成2028年接班人选拔赛
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在白宫新闻发布会上似乎在考察万斯和卢比奥作为潜在接班人的表现。尽管斯蒂芬·米勒意外抢镜，但整场活动被外界解读为特朗普在测试其潜在继任者的忠诚度与能力。
items.whyImportant: 这一动态凸显了特朗普在第二任期内对共和党未来领导权的影响力，以及党内潜在继任者之间的竞争态势。

items.title: Man, 61, arrested over fake Chanel, Dior perfumes sold in alleged scam run by his son
items.summary: A 61-year-old Hong Kong man has been arrested on suspicion of selling fake luxury perfume in an online scam operation that made more than HK$6 million (US$765,500) in illicit profits over the past two years. Customs officials, who also accused the man of money laundering, said the suspect had operated the Hong Kong side of the business for his 30-year-old son, who is alleged to have masterminded the scam operation from overseas. On Saturday, the Customs and Excise Department revealed that it had...
items.titleZh: 61岁男子因涉嫌参与其子经营的假冒香水诈骗案被捕
items.summaryZh: 一名61岁香港男子因涉嫌参与销售假冒香水诈骗案被捕，该团伙在两年内非法获利超过600万港元。警方指控该男子协助其身处海外的儿子运营香港业务，并涉及洗钱活动。
items.whyImportant: 此案揭示了跨境网络诈骗的运作模式，并提醒消费者警惕在线购买奢侈品的风险。

items.title: Using IDs to check concert tickets, combat scalping could slow entry: tourism chief
items.summary: Hong Kong’s tourism chief has warned that requiring fans to show identity cards that match the names on their concert tickets to combat scalping could slow entry at venues, saying arrangements would need to be discussed with organisers for each event. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui also told a radio programme on Saturday that the city could record around 55 million visitor arrivals this year, 1.2 million more than the government’s earlier estimate of 53.8...
items.titleZh: 旅游局长：使用身份证核对演唱会门票以打击黄牛可能会减慢入场速度
items.summaryZh: 香港文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄表示，通过核对身份证件打击演唱会黄牛票可能会导致入场效率降低，需与主办方协商具体安排。同时，预计今年香港访客量将达到5500万人次。
items.whyImportant: 该讨论平衡了打击票务欺诈与提升大型活动运营效率之间的矛盾，对香港旅游及娱乐产业具有参考意义。

items.title: China’s EV adoption rate to top 70% as petrol cars take brunt of drop in overall sales
items.summary: Seven out of 10 car buyers in mainland China this month will opt for electric vehicles (EVs), as petrol-guzzling options fall further out of favour in the world’s largest market, according to an industry consortium. The country’s carmakers were expected to deliver 1.15 million EVs – comprising pure-electric and plug-in hybrids – to mainland customers in November, equal to 70.6 per cent of total car sales, the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) said in a statement on Thursday. If the...
items.titleZh: 中国电动汽车普及率将超过70%，燃油车销量遭受重创
items.summaryZh: 中国乘用车市场协会数据显示，本月中国电动汽车（含纯电和插混）销量占比预计将达到70.6%。随着消费者偏好转向新能源，传统燃油车的市场份额正持续萎缩。
items.whyImportant: 这一数据标志着中国汽车市场向电动化转型的速度远超预期，将重塑全球汽车产业格局。

items.title: COP31: Countries demand stronger climate deal as talks in Antalya reach final day
items.summary: A group of countries from Europe, Africa, Latin America and the Pacific has challenged the proposed COP31 agreement, demanding explicit action on fossil fuels and stronger climate finance. With the summit due to close on Friday, tensions are rising as activists warn the talks are headed for failure, and negotiators search for a deal that nearly 200 governments can accept.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: COP31：安塔利亚气候谈判进入最后一天，各国要求达成更强有力的协议
items.summaryZh: 来自欧洲、非洲、拉丁美洲和太平洋地区的国家对COP31拟议协议提出质疑，要求明确针对化石燃料采取行动并加强气候融资。随着峰会即将结束，谈判代表正努力寻求各方都能接受的方案。
items.whyImportant: 此次谈判的结果将直接影响全球应对气候变化的政策方向和承诺力度。

items.title: Who are you calling a ‘Chinese honeypot’?
items.summary: “Please stop being such a Chinese honeypot.” When reports emerged alleging that then-Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang had been romantically involved with a Chinese woman suspected of espionage, my inbox filled with remarks from friends and acquaintances about my supposed career as a Chinese spy. One came from an old university mate I hadn’t seen in more than a decade. Underneath the humour was a more revealing assumption. I am a British woman of Vietnamese-Chinese ancestry, with no family...
items.titleZh: 你管谁叫“中国美人计”？
items.summaryZh: 作者分享了因其亚裔背景而遭受种族偏见和无端指控的经历。文章探讨了在涉及地缘政治的背景下，针对亚裔女性的刻板印象和歧视性言论如何影响个人生活。
items.whyImportant: 该文揭示了当前社会中针对特定族裔的偏见问题及其对个人造成的心理和社会影响。

items.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
items.summary: New York’s Rikers Island jail complex would close by 2032 under a sweeping plan announced on Friday by Mayor Zohran Mamdani, whose strategy for finally shuttering the notorious facility hinges on substantially reducing the number of people kept behind bars. The mayor, a Democrat, unveiled the plan as the city is all but certain to blow past a legal requirement to close Rikers and replace it with four smaller, more modern jails by 2027. For years, Rikers Island has stood as a symbol of...
items.titleZh: 马姆达尼宣布计划在2032年前关闭纽约赖克斯岛监狱
items.summaryZh: 纽约市长马姆达尼宣布了一项新计划，旨在通过大幅减少在押人员数量，于2032年前关闭赖克斯岛监狱。该计划旨在取代此前未能按期完成的监狱改造项目。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着纽约市在刑事司法改革和监狱系统管理方面采取了新的政策方向。
